definition: TorchAudio is PyTorch’s audio package: loading audio, spectrograms, resampling and pretrained speech models.
details: Part of the PyTorch project at Meta, maintained by the PyTorch Foundation.

explainer.lead: How to install TorchAudio, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.

quickstart.python:
import torchaudio

waveform, sr = torchaudio.load("speech.wav")
mel = torchaudio.transforms.MelSpectrogram(sample_rate=sr, n_mels=80)(waveform)
print(waveform.shape, mel.shape)

explainer.inAi: Turn raw audio into the mel spectrograms speech and audio models expect.
explainer.jsNote: TorchAudio is a Python library with no official JavaScript or TypeScript package; call it from a Python service if your app is written in JavaScript.
